vulnerability.$note: From the 2026 bulk release, latest available year. ND-GAIN restates earlier years between releases (Cambodia 2021 read 40.1 in the edition cited by data/khm.json and 40.665 here); rank is not in the bulk file.

series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

derived.$reason: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against.

country_profile.$note: Population is World Bank SP.POP.TOTL for the latest year published in the 2015-2025 window. Income group is the World Bank's own classification, not a UNFCCC one.

ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: Uruguay presents global 2025 climate change mitigation objectives of its NDC regarding intensity in relation to its gross domestic product and to base year 1990. It also includes specific objectives related to Food Production (beef) and Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry (LULUCF).
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: 2025 mitigation objective of intensity reduction (GHG emissions per GDP unit) from base year 1990 of 24% in CO2, 57% in CH4, 48% in N2O (unconditional), and 29% in CO2, 59% in CH4, 52% in N2O (conditional)
ndc_assessment.sectors: "All emitting sectors as acknowledged by IPCC inventory guidelines are considered. "
ndc_assessment.$note: Third-party assessment of the first (I)NDC round. It is not merged into ndc.*, is not used by derive(), and does not appear on the dial as a target.

target_text.text:
Target 1: Reducir 24% la intensidad de emisiones de CO2 de los sectores Energía e IPPU por unidad de PIB con respecto a 1990.
Target 2: Reducir 57% la intensidad de emisiones de CH4 de los sectores Energía, Agricultura (incluida la Ganadería), Desechos e IPPU por unidad de PIB con respecto a 1990.
Target 3: Reducir 48% la intensidad de emisiones de N2O de los sectores Energía, Agricultura (incluida la Ganadería), Desechos e IPPU por unidad de PIB con respecto a 1990.
Target 4: Reducir 32% la intensidad de emisiones de CH4 de la producción de carne vacuna por unidad de producto (carne vacuna en peso vivo) con respecto a 1990.
Target 5: Reducir 34% la intensidad de emisiones de N2O de la producción de carne vacuna por unidad de producto (carne vacuna en peso vivo) con respecto a 1990.
Target 6: Mantener el 100% de la superficie de bosque nativo  del año 2012 (849.960 ha) 
Target 7: Al menos mantener el 100% de la cantidad de superficie efectiva en manejo de plantaciones forestales del año 2015 (763.070 ha) 
Target 8: Mantener el 100% de la superficie de plantaciones forestales con destino sombra y abrigo del año 2012 (77.790 ha) 
Target 9: Evitar las emisiones de CO2 del COS en el 10% de la superficie de pastizales (1.000.000 ha) 
Target 10: Evitar las emisiones de CO2 del COS en el 50% de la superficie de turberas del año 2016 (4.183 ha) 
Target 11: Evitar las emisiones de CO2 del COS en el 75% de la superficie de cultivos bajo Planes de Uso y Manejo del Suelo del año 2016 (1.147.000 ha), así como secuestrar CO2 en el 25% de la superficie restante (383.000 ha)

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is Third NDC, filed 2024-12-30. 60 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (14). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 43.1 MtCO₂e, DS-02 33.8 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 54.7 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 2025 mitigation objective of intensity reduction (GHG emissions per GDP unit) from base year 1990 of 24% in CO2, 57% in CH4, 48% in N2O (unconditional), and 29% in CO2, 59% in CH4, 52% in N2O (conditional) It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.86°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.35°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
